0022600223.text: The Pelicans (4-7, 3-3 at home) enter this 12th game of the season on a three-game losing streak, with a 4-6 record over their last ten and a 12th-place standing in the West, 5 games back in the Southwest. Brooklyn (2-8, 1-3 at home) is 13th in the East, 6.5 games back in the Atlantic, and has lost two straight. New Orleans is without Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Brooklyn is missing Mikel Brown Jr. (illness) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Pelicans winning the most recent meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026.
